philosophy.title: Own businesses, not tickers.
philosophy.body: We value companies on what they can earn.

philosophy.title: Look where others don't.
philosophy.body: A fund of engineers, scientists, and economists reads a company differently.

philosophy.title: Write it down.
philosophy.body: Every thesis states what would prove it wrong.

approaches.title: Fundamental research
approaches.body: We start with the business: what it earns, what it is worth, and what the market is missing.

approaches.title: Creative approaches
approaches.body: We look for an edge where a standard model stops.

process.title: Source
process.body: Analysts screen their coverage group for mispriced companies.

process.title: Research
process.body: A team of [3 to 4] builds the model, the thesis, and the risks over [X] weeks.

process.title: Pitch
process.body: The team presents to the full fund and takes questions.

process.title: Vote and monitor
process.body: Members vote. Approved ideas enter the portfolio and are reviewed [each semester].

samplePitch.thesis: [The thesis in two sentences: what the market is missing, and what would prove it.] [Second sentence.]
samplePitch.outcome: [Outcome: approved or passed, and what happened next.]
